fields.label: Hub Site
fields.description: Frappe site name on the hub bench, sent as the Host header — hub_url is often a Docker service name (e.g. http://hub:8000), which is not itself a valid Frappe site

fields.label: Vendor ID
fields.description: Assigned by SaathiMart admin e.g. vendor-a

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Legacy token-auth credential, unused by current HMAC-based hub sync (see webhook_secret below).

fields.label: API Secret
fields.description: Legacy token-auth credential, unused by current HMAC-based hub sync (see webhook_secret below).

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Shared secret for verifying inbound hub webhooks

fields.label: Previous Webhook Secret
fields.description: Accepted (never sent) during zero-downtime secret rotation.

fields.label: Staged Next Secret
fields.description: Hub-staged secret accepted during rotation; promoted to primary on promote signal.

fields.label: Last Event Seq
fields.description: Last event sequence number pushed to hub for idempotency

fields.label: Last Hub Event Seq
fields.description: Last event sequence number received from hub for ordering

fields.label: Admin Email
fields.description: Receives alerts when outbox entries die or hub is unreachable

fields.label: Warehouses
fields.description: Multi-location warehouses synced from the hub. Each maps to an ERPNext Warehouse on this site.

fields.label: Warehouse Synced At
fields.description: When warehouses were last synced from the hub
